class.name: HTMLProgressElement
class.description: Represents [code]<progress>[/code]. Remove the value attribute for indeterminate progress.

method.name: get_labels
method.description: Returns associated [HTMLLabelElement] handles in tree order.

members.member: The current value clamped to the effective range.
The positive maximum. Missing and invalid values use 1.
The fraction completed, or -1 for indeterminate progress.
